records.issue_text: [BUG] i.content is called with no nil check, so any feed item lacking a <content> element (summary/description-only feeds are common) crashes the whole poll. A single item without content raises NoMethodError on nil, aborting the items loop mid-feed, so all subsequent feed items — including new articles — are silently never imported; the hourly schedule retries the same failure every hour with no error surfacing (retry: false).
records.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` with no guard. If a feed item lacks `content` (i.e., `i.content` is `nil`), calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError` and abort `rss.items.each`, preventing subsequent items from importing. This is unhandled in the job, and the job explicitly sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so it won’t automatically retry with backoff or self-heal once a problematic item appears.

```rb
return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]

```

This verifiably skips `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` for `raw_html` posts created by `TopicEmbed.import` (which passes `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). That changes/breaks the `after_post_cook` hook behavior for imported/embedded topics, so plugins relying on that hook won’t run for these posts.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The disqus import task silently changes objective: it drops the `--category` option and replaces the local permalink-post creation with a remote fetch via TopicEmbed.import_remote, altering what the command produces.
